name: gate-separation-ab
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-30, before any run. Separates the two gates armed together in both-gates-endtoend-ab (control 0/3, both 2/3) and supplies a second cohort. HYPOTHESIS: type_contract carries most of the effect -- its defect occurred 6/6 in recorded runs while lexical_smoke fired in only 1 of 3 candidate runs, consistent with ~50% incidence. PRIMARY METRIC: hidden-contract pass rate per arm. ENGAGEMENT CHECK: typeContractRejections must be non-zero in the type-only and both arms; a zero makes that arm's pass rate unattributable, as happened in unchanged-verify-progress-ab. SECONDARY: turns, to price each gate separately against control's fail-fast 9/8/10. FALSIFIED IF: type-only performs no better than control, which would mean the both-arm result came from lexical_smoke or from variance. NOTE: pooled with the earlier cohort this yields n=6 for control and both, which is still short of the repeated-seeded-cohort bar for promotion.
